doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Parker's nickname Bird and his style
summary: Wilder does not know where Bird came from; Parker was a swinging player.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: So this is before he got nicknamed Bird.
Yeah, this is before Bird. Yeah, this is before that.
Do you know where that came from?
I’m not sure. I’m really not sure.
I’ve heard a lot of different stories.
I wouldn’t venture to say, because I don’t really know, and I was rather surprised when I found out that he was Bird, when I first heard it.
When you heard him in the early ’40s, was he someone who you wanted then to try to play like? Or was his style so personal that you thought, this is not a style I can imitate?
